title: Deliver dev.6 Durable Wait
goal: Ship one restart-safe Wait and opaque Signal flow that consumes no AI slot and settles exactly once.

prompt.objective: Add known-red tests for opaque Signal identity, restart persistence, idempotent resolution, timeout reconciliation, pause shifting, cancellation, and no-Actor scheduling.
instructions: Assert Waiting owns no Assignment and consumes no Actor slot.
Separate read-only overdue observation from mutating reconciliation.
Keep Signal summaries and evidence bounded and project-relative.
doneWhen: Restart, equivalent/conflicting resolve, stale Signal, timeout, pause, cancel, Actor/no-Actor, and capacity tests fail against dev.5 for the intended reason.
Read-only projections prove no revision or route mutation.
Expected public errors are stable and contain no private payload.
forbidden: Do not implement the candidate while defining the red contract.
Do not alter Gate process behavior.

prompt.objective: Persist one Wait, close every service process, reopen the project, and prove the same bounded Signal remains actionable.
instructions: Use only project-local SQLite and public service boundaries.
Record revision before and after read-only overdue inspection.
Exercise unrelated AI scheduling while the Signal waits.
doneWhen: The Signal ID and legal routes survive process restart.
No Assignment is created for Wait.
forbidden: Do not require a resident daemon.
Do not use wall-clock sleeps as the primary oracle.

prompt.objective: Implement persistent Wait transitions, opaque Signal resolution, deadline reconciliation, pause/resume shifting, cancellation staleness, inspection, and progressive CLI Help.
instructions: Settle System Nodes transactionally without creating an AI Assignment.
Equivalent Signal resolution returns the original receipt; conflicts never mutate.
Advance overdue routes only from bounded mutating entry points.
doneWhen: Wait enters Waiting with one opaque Signal and no Assignment.
Resolve with and without Actor follows normal capacity and returns bounded successors.
Restart, timeout, pause, resume, cancellation, replay, conflict, and stale handles satisfy focused tests.
CLI inspection and Help expose safe recovery without private payloads.
forbidden: No Signal payload, secret, or absolute path in public state.

prompt.objective: Exercise restart, unrelated scheduling, idempotent/conflicting Signal resolution, read-only overdue state, explicit timeout reconciliation, pause duration, cancellation, package behavior, and bounded context.
instructions: Use injected clocks for timeout or pause assertions.
Restart the service between Wait creation and resolution.
Verify both resolve modes: without Actor and with Actor.
doneWhen: One Signal settles exactly once across restart.
Unrelated work advances while Wait owns no Actor slot.
Pause excludes frozen duration and cancellation makes the Signal stale.
Source and isolated-package UP08 pass without leaked payloads.
forbidden: Do not weaken assertions to pass.
Do not use unbounded sleep or output.

prompt.objective: Select pass only when UP08 and every Wait-owned S06 clause pass with persistence, timeout, lifecycle, privacy, capacity, and package evidence.
instructions: Choose repair for any duplicate settlement, stale Signal mutation, read-only mutation, Actor-capacity, clock, payload, or package blocker.
Cite exact commands and restart controls.
doneWhen: All Wait contract, source, installed-package, restart, timeout, and lifecycle Gates pass.
No unresolved blocker or unaccepted debt remains.
forbidden: Do not route pass from a partial or source-only verification.
